cast.speaker: Chantelle
cast.description: A young woman in her early 20s with a thick, loud, bubbly Essex accent. Wildly overconfident hustle-culture girlboss, gullible, dramatic and very expressive, talking on her phone while walking outside, with big emotional swings from excited to defensive to wounded.
